title: Runtime C: just a user, no agent
lede: Sam signs in as himself through a different PingOne app: no agent screen, no consent, and his own token is denied at the gateway.

lanes.label: C. Just a user, no agent: Sam signs in as himself

nodes.label: 2. PingOne sign-in
sub: the Muse user login app: no agent screen, no consent

nodes.label: 4. Straight to the gateway
sub: DENIED: no agent acting for him

steps.title: Sign in
steps.what: Sam clicks "Sign in as Sam (no agent)".
steps.why: A human login, shown next to the agent login.

steps.title: Own token
steps.what: The Muse user login app is not the Muse app, so there is no agent screen and no consent. PingOne issues Sam’s own token.
steps.why: The flow decides by app id.

steps.title: Denied
steps.what: Muse sends Sam’s own token straight to the gateway. No act claim and the wrong audience: 401.
steps.why: Only a token that names an agent acting for Sam gets through.
